Hello! I'm excited to share some insights from our recent classroom observation. 

One major strength we noticed was how effectively you used culturally relevant examples, like the cake-sharing scenario, to introduce fractions. This approach made the lesson relatable and helped students connect abstract concepts to their daily lives. Students were engaged and shared personal stories, which was great to see.

Now, let's talk about a growth opportunity. While your lesson had a lot of teacher-led confirmations, incorporating a specific feedback frame could really enhance student understanding. Try using the phrase, "You're correct about X; next, try Y," for at least three student turns. This will guide them on what to improve and encourage deeper learning.

Thanks for your commitment to fostering a positive learning environment. Keep up the great work, and remember, small changes can have a big impact!
